agent_integrity_events_service_check.name: agent_integrity_events_service_check
agent_integrity_events_service_check.value: service IS NULL OR service IN ('broker','worker')

agent_integrity_events_target_check.name: agent_integrity_events_target_check
agent_integrity_events_target_check.value: target IS NULL OR target IN ('service-dacl','service-sid','service-recovery','folder-agent','folder-plugins','folder-staging')

agent_integrity_events_start_type_check.name: agent_integrity_events_start_type_check
agent_integrity_events_start_type_check.value: start_type IS NULL OR start_type IN ('manual','disabled','unknown')

agent_integrity_events_reason_check.name: agent_integrity_events_reason_check
agent_integrity_events_reason_check.value: reason IS NULL OR reason IN ('local-uninstall','service-deleted')

agent_release_source_status_check.name: agent_release_source_status_check
agent_release_source_status_check.value: last_status IS NULL OR last_status IN ('ok','failed')

alert_rule_overrides_level_check.name: alert_rule_overrides_level_check
alert_rule_overrides_level_check.value: level IS NULL OR level IN ('info','warning','critical')

alerts_close_reason_check.name: alerts_close_reason_check
alerts_close_reason_check.value: close_reason IS NULL OR close_reason IN ('recovered','rule-off','no-data')

alerts_closed_check.name: alerts_closed_check
alerts_closed_check.value: (state = 'closed') = (closed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (state = 'closed') = (close_reason IS NOT NULL)

customer_installers_max_devices.name: customer_installers_max_devices
customer_installers_max_devices.value: max_devices IS NULL OR (max_devices BETWEEN 1 AND 10000)

customer_installers_enrollments.name: customer_installers_enrollments
customer_installers_enrollments.value: enrollments>=0 AND (max_devices IS NULL OR enrollments<=max_devices)

customers_settings_valid.name: customers_settings_valid
customers_settings_valid.value: (audit_retention_days IS NULL OR audit_retention_days BETWEEN 1 AND 3650) AND ((maintenance_days IS NULL AND maintenance_start IS NULL AND maintenance_duration IS NULL AND maintenance_time_zone IS NULL) OR (maintenance_days IS NOT NULL AND maintenance_start IS NOT NULL AND maintenance_duration IS NOT NULL AND maintenance_time_zone IS NOT NULL AND maintenance_days BETWEEN 1 AND 127 AND maintenance_start BETWEEN 0 AND 1425 AND maintenance_start%15=0 AND maintenance_duration BETWEEN 15 AND 720 AND maintenance_duration%15=0 AND length(maintenance_time_zone) BETWEEN 1 AND 64)) AND revision>=0

desired_assignment_last_result.name: desired_assignment_last_result
desired_assignment_last_result.value: (last_job_id IS NULL AND last_result_state IS NULL AND last_result_at IS NULL) OR (last_job_id IS NOT NULL AND last_result_state IS NOT NULL AND last_result_at IS NOT NULL)

device_autostart_flags_check.name: device_autostart_flags_check
device_autostart_flags_check.value: microsoft IN (0,1) AND user_path IN (0,1) AND baseline IN (0,1)

device_drivers_signed_check.name: device_drivers_signed_check
device_drivers_signed_check.value: signed IS NULL OR signed IN (0,1)

entra_directory_check_result.name: entra_directory_check_result
entra_directory_check_result.value: last_result IS NULL OR last_result IN ('ok','permissionMissing','credentialRefused','secretExpired','certificateRefused','unavailable')

entra_directory_check_counts.name: entra_directory_check_counts
entra_directory_check_counts.value: checked_count >= 0 AND locked_count >= 0 AND group_change_count >= 0 AND remaining_count >= 0

entra_settings_emergency.name: entra_settings_emergency
entra_settings_emergency.value: entra_only = 0 OR emergency_user_id IS NOT NULL

entra_settings_test_result.name: entra_settings_test_result
entra_settings_test_result.value: test_result IS NULL OR test_result IN ('ok','tenantNotFound','discoveryFailed','credentialRefused','secretExpired','certificateRefused','unreachable','graphPermissionMissing','graphUnreachable','apiNotExposed','apiTokenVersion')

entra_settings_complete.name: entra_settings_complete
entra_settings_complete.value: enabled = 0 OR (tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND client_id IS NOT NULL AND ((credential_kind = 'secret' AND secret_enc IS NOT NULL) OR (credential_kind = 'certificate' AND certificate_pem IS NOT NULL AND private_key_enc IS NOT NULL AND certificate_thumbprint IS NOT NULL)))

entra_sign_in_flows_confirm_fields.name: entra_sign_in_flows_confirm_fields
entra_sign_in_flows_confirm_fields.value: (purpose = 'confirm' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND primary_hash IS NOT NULL AND claim_hash IS NOT NULL AND settings_revision IS NOT NULL) OR (purpose = 'sign-in' AND user_id IS NULL AND primary_hash IS NULL AND claim_hash IS NULL AND settings_revision IS NULL AND confirmed_at IS NULL AND outcome IS NULL)

entra_sign_in_flows_result.name: entra_sign_in_flows_result
entra_sign_in_flows_result.value: confirmed_at IS NULL OR outcome IS NULL

entra_sign_in_flows_outcome.name: entra_sign_in_flows_outcome
entra_sign_in_flows_outcome.value: outcome IS NULL OR outcome IN ('cancelled','expired','mfaMissing','apiSetupMissing','wrongTenant','wrongAccount','staleSignIn','accountDisabled','tokenRejected','unavailable','notConfigured')

jobs_concurrency.name: jobs_concurrency
jobs_concurrency.value: concurrency IS NULL OR concurrency IN ('parallel','exclusive','sole')

local_users_entra_identity.name: local_users_entra_identity
local_users_entra_identity.value: (identity_source = 'local' AND entra_tenant_id IS NULL AND entra_object_id IS NULL) OR (identity_source = 'entra' AND entra_tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND entra_object_id IS NOT NULL AND password_hash IS NULL AND must_reset = 0 AND auth_principal = 'entra:' || entra_tenant_id || ':' || entra_object_id)

maintenance_runs_result.name: maintenance_runs_result
maintenance_runs_result.value: result IS NULL OR result IS JSON

notification_deliveries_recipients_check.name: notification_deliveries_recipients_check
notification_deliveries_recipients_check.value: recipients IS NULL OR recipients IS JSON ARRAY

notification_deliveries_attempts_check.name: notification_deliveries_attempts_check
notification_deliveries_attempts_check.value: attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND recovered IN (0,1)

notification_deliveries_error_params_che.name: notification_deliveries_error_params_check
notification_deliveries_error_params_che.value: error_params IS NULL OR error_params IS JSON OBJECT

notification_events_level_check.name: notification_events_level_check
notification_events_level_check.value: level IS NULL OR level IN ('info','warning','critical')

notification_events_alarm_check.name: notification_events_alarm_check
notification_events_alarm_check.value: (kind IN ('test','emergency')) = (alert_id IS NULL) AND (kind IN ('test','emergency')) = (server_id IS NULL) AND (kind = 'test') = (level IS NULL) AND (kind <> 'emergency' OR level = 'critical')

notification_events_close_reason_check.name: notification_events_close_reason_check
notification_events_close_reason_check.value: (kind = 'close') = (close_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (close_reason IS NULL OR close_reason IN ('recovered','rule-off','no-data'))

notification_events_suppressed_check.name: notification_events_suppressed_check
notification_events_suppressed_check.value: (status = 'suppressed') = (suppressed_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (suppressed_reason IS NULL OR suppressed_reason IN ('muted','maintenance-window','not-notified','no-rule','no-recipient'))

notification_rules_flags_check.name: notification_rules_flags_check
notification_rules_flags_check.value: on_open IN (0,1) AND on_close IN (0,1) AND on_escalate IN (0,1) AND enabled IN (0,1) AND on_open + on_close + on_escalate >= 1

plugin_ad_sessions_active_check.name: plugin_ad_sessions_active_check
plugin_ad_sessions_active_check.value: state <> 'active' OR (user_sid IS NOT NULL AND verified_at IS NOT NULL)

rdp_rtc_answer_size.name: rdp_rtc_answer_size
rdp_rtc_answer_size.value: answer IS NULL OR length(answer) BETWEEN 24 AND 65536

rdp_session_ack.name: rdp_session_ack
rdp_session_ack.value: input_ack>=0 AND input_ack<=input_seq AND output_ack>=0 AND output_ack<=output_seq

samples_gpus.name: samples_gpus
samples_gpus.value: gpus IS NULL OR (length(gpus)<=65536 AND CASE WHEN gpus IS JSON ARRAY THEN jsonb_array_length(gpus::jsonb)<=16 ELSE false END)

vulnerability_sync_status_check.name: vulnerability_sync_status_check
vulnerability_sync_status_check.value: last_status IS NULL OR last_status IN ('ok','failed')

vulnerability_sync_cvelist_status_check.name: vulnerability_sync_cvelist_status_check
vulnerability_sync_cvelist_status_check.value: cvelist_last_status IS NULL OR cvelist_last_status IN ('ok','failed')
